label: prf:confined-knot-binding
title: Proof of confined knot binding
html:
Proof. The equality W_{\mathrm{sym}} = W_{\mathrm{alt}} follows from \dim_q(\lambda_{\mathrm{sym}}) = \dim_q(\lambda_{\mathrm{alt}}) = 1 for the one-dimensional representations of H_3(R, q). The Wedderburn weight is w_\lambda = d_q(\lambda)^2 / [n]_q!, and d_q((3)) = d_q((1,1,1)) = 1.

For the symmetric crossing (c, d) = (1, -h_{\mathrm{A}}/2):

  \chi_{\mathrm{sym}} + \chi_{\mathrm{alt}}
  = (q - h_{\mathrm{A}}/2) + (-q^{-1} - h_{\mathrm{A}}/2)
  = q - q^{-1} - h_{\mathrm{A}} = 0

since h_{\mathrm{A}} = q - q^{-1}. Therefore the weighted sum vanishes: W_{\mathrm{sym}} \cdot \chi_{\mathrm{sym}} + W_{\mathrm{alt}} \cdot \chi_{\mathrm{alt}} = W_{\mathrm{sym}}(\chi_{\mathrm{sym}} + \chi_{\mathrm{alt}}) = 0.

The standard-representation volume z - h_{\mathrm{A}}/2 follows from the transfer matrix with initial condition (a_0, b_0) = (0, 1): (a, b) = (1, -h_{\mathrm{A}}/2), giving \chi_{\mathrm{std}} = z \cdot 1 + (-h_{\mathrm{A}}/2) = z - h_{\mathrm{A}}/2.

For a general confined state at jet level \ell, the character ratio a_\ell compares the accumulated Wedderburn volume of the confined braid word against the tensor product of free constituent volumes. The product \prod_\ell a_\ell telescopes through the jet tower:

  \prod_\ell a_\ell
  = \frac{\hat{V}(\text{nucleus})}
         {\prod_{\text{nucleons}} \hat{V}(\text{nucleon})}
  \cdot
  \frac{\prod_{\text{nucleons}} \hat{V}(\text{nucleon})}
       {\prod_{\text{quarks}} \hat{V}(\text{quark})}
  \cdot \dotsb

Each factor is determined by the Hecke algebra multiplication rules applied to the crossing parameters at that level. \square
